sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: The linking process allows devices to be connected to the MySmartWindow system for control via the mobile application. There are three linking methods, each with a different operation, ordered by speed and reliability.

methods.name: Multi-linking (Multicast Method)
methods.definition: An automatic connection method where the application sends WiFi credentials to multiple devices simultaneously through the local network (broadcast/multicast).

methods.name: AP Method (Point-to-Point)
methods.definition: A direct connection between the mobile device and the device through a private WiFi network created by the device.

methods.name: App Method (Assisted Linking)
methods.definition: A guided method where the user configures the device step by step through the app assistant using pre-configured WiFi networks.
